name: Gilmour Comfortably Numb lead
description: Big Muff fuzz into a clean high-headroom British amp, long ~quarter-note analog delay, light hall reverb, compression for sustain.

name: SRV Texas blues
description: Loud Fender-style amp at edge of breakup, Tube Screamer pushing mids, very touch sensitive, light spring reverb.

name: Hendrix fuzz rhythm
description: Fuzz Face into a cranked Marshall-style amp, optional wah, plenty of midrange and hair.

name: Modern metal rhythm
description: High-gain amp, noise gate before the amp for tightness, slight scoop EQ, tight cab. Minimal time effects.

name: Ambient clean wash
description: Pristine clean amp, light compression, dotted-eighth delay, large hall/shimmer reverb, subtle chorus.

name: Country chicken pickin'
description: Bright clean Fender-style tone, strong compression for snap, slap-back delay, minimal reverb.

name: Classic rock crunch
description: Cranked Plexi-style amp, midrange-forward, light overdrive boost for solos, small room reverb.

name: AC/DC rhythm
description: Marshall-style crunch, no master volume sag, no boost, just amp and pick attack. Dry, punchy, mid-forward.

name: Thrash metal rhythm
description: Tight high-gain amp, aggressive mids, noise gate, slight low-cut for palm-mute clarity. Bone dry.

name: Doom/stoner fuzz
description: Massive fuzz into a mid-gain amp, low and thick, slow and heavy. A touch of room.

name: Jazz archtop clean
description: Warm, dark clean tone with rolled-off highs, gentle compression, no drive, tiny room ambience.

name: Funk rhythm
description: Bright clean tone, strong compression for percussive consistency, auto-wah/envelope filter, no reverb.

name: Indie jangle
description: Chimey clean amp, light chorus for shimmer, slap reverb, compressed for even strumming.

name: Shoegaze wall
description: Layered fuzz into clean amp, heavy reverb and modulation, drowned in effects, long decay.

name: Punk rock
description: Bright distorted amp, fast and raw, slight presence boost, no time effects. In your face.

name: Prog rock lead
description: Smooth high-gain lead, compression for sustain, stereo delay, light reverb. Liquid singing tone.

name: Surf rock
description: Bright clean Fender tone drenched in spring reverb with tremolo. Iconic 60s surf sound.

name: Worship/ambient swell
description: Clean amp with volume swells, dotted-eighth + quarter delays stacked, big reverb, shimmer. Pad-like.

name: Blues lead overdrive
description: Mid-gain amp pushed by a transparent overdrive, vocal midrange, light delay and room. Expressive.

name: Nu-metal scoop
description: Scooped high-gain tone for drop tunings, heavy gate, tight low end, no time effects. Groovy and chunky.

name: Country lead twang
description: Snappy bright clean-to-breakup tone, heavy compression, slapback, for bends and double-stops.

name: Post-rock crescendo
description: Clean-to-driven dynamic tone built for crescendos: light drive, long delays, enormous reverb, tremolo picking friendly.
